newsitem.title: USA: Kevco Inc to acquire wood products co.
newsitem.headline: Kevco Inc to acquire wood products co.

text.p: Kevco Inc said Tueday it has signed a definitive purchase contract to acquire Consolidated Forest Products, a privately held manufacturer of wood products, for about $13.87 million.
Under the deal, Kevco said it also will assume Consolidated's working capital debt. The closing is expected to take place within about 30 days.
Consolidated Forest is based in Haleyville, Ala.
Kevco is a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of building products for the manufactured housing and recreational-vehicle industries.
